messages.text:
"Create a realistic 3D PUBG PC-level Battle Royale game with a massive 16 × 16 km seamless open-world map.

Include huge cities, villages, military bases, airports, forests, mountains, deserts, rivers, bridges and enterable buildings.

Features:

- 100-player Battle Royale with AI bots.
- Solo, Duo and Squad modes.
- Aircraft insertion and parachuting.
- Realistic guns, recoil, aiming and reloading.
- Inventory, loot, armor and shrinking blue zone.
- Cars, jeeps, bikes, boats and helicopters.
- Realistic graphics, lighting, shadows, weather and day/night cycle.
- First-person and third-person camera.
- Intelligent enemies and realistic combat.

Optimization: Keep installation size small using compressed assets, world streaming, LOD and occlusion culling. Avoid unnecessary files and dependencies. Ensure smooth FPS and stable gameplay.

Create a complete, polished, playable PC game with a massive map and immersive realistic graphics.
"
